title: German Black Bean Crumble
description: A hearty German-inspired dish with a warm and comforting crumble topping, featuring black beans and Italian flavors.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cooked black beans, Italian seasoning, and salt. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the bean mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
In a small bowl, mix together the brown sugar and warm water until dissolved.
Add the crumble topping to the bowl and mix until crumbly.
Spread the crumble topping evenly over the bean mixture.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the beans are heated through.
